note: The track content of Geometry Race 1.9.7 as serialized in the AssetRipper export: the three worlds' section sequences (LevelManager/Levels/Level*: ConstantSection / RandomSection / SectionSequence in hierarchy order, notes 8) and every block prefab they use — its BlockDetails (id, StartLeft, EndRight), ObstacleManager, the colliders of its obstacles in the block's own frame (type, tag, layer, centre, size, rotation), the power-up spawn points and the animators (MovingBlock, FallingPillar, movers, rotations...; notes 11, 12), the parts drawn with every collider (mesh, materials, transform in the block's frame, the object drawn — one renderer, or every one below a compound object) and the first part's materials, and a table of the materials (texture, tint, the texture's top/middle/bottom colours and a 17-sample ramp along v; notes 15). Reference only, for tools/matchtrack.mjs (GR-M6): the output stays in sources/extract/json/, outside git; the game's own sections are data/sections.json (checkdata.mjs sees to it that they are not these).
